note_title: 广义调和级数部分和的渐近展开
summary_en: This note studies asymptotic expansions of partial sums of generalized harmonic series using the Euler-Maclaurin summation formula, with applications to tail estimates and polynomial sum formulas. It connects these expansions to the Basel problem, the Riemann zeta function, analytic continuation, Bernoulli numbers, and Faulhaber's formula.

problems.statement_en:
Let
$$S(N):=\zeta(2)-\sum_{n\leq N}\frac{1}{n^2}.$$ Find an asymptotic expansion of $S(N)$ up to the coefficient of $\frac{1}{N}$.
problems.statement_zh: 求$$S(N):=\zeta(2)-\sum_{n\leq N}\frac{1}{n^2}$$的精确到$\frac{1}{N}$系数的渐近展开。

problems.statement_en:
General asymptotic result for generalized harmonic numbers: if $r>0$ and $r\neq 1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+O\left(n^{-r-3}\right).$$
If $r=1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-1}=\gamma+\log(n) + \frac{1}{2} n^{-1}-\frac{1}{12} n^{-2}+O\left(n^{-4}\right).$$
problems.statement_zh:
如果$r>0,r \neq 1$的时候，
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+O\left(n^{-r-3}\right)$$
如果$r=1$的时候,$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-1}=\gamma+\log(n) + \frac{1}{2} n^{-1}-\frac{1}{12} n^{-2}+O\left(n^{-4}\right)$$

problems.statement_en:
If $r>1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+O\left(n^{-r-3}\right).$$

If $r>1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+E_r(n),$$
where the remainder satisfies
$$|E_r(n)|<\frac{r(r+1)(r+2)}{720n^{r+3}}.$$

Find the asymptotic expansion of
$$\sum_{k\leq n}\sqrt{k},$$
in particular its constant term. The note gives
$$\sum_{k\leq n}\sqrt{k}=\frac{2}{3}n^{3/2}+\frac{1}{2}n^{1/2}+\zeta(-1/2)+\frac{1}{24}n^{-1/2}+O(n^{-5/2}).$$
problems.statement_zh:
求$$\sum_{k\leq n}\sqrt{k}$$的渐近展开，特别是需要得到其常数项的渐近系数。

那么根据上面的公式，此时相当于$r=-1/2$于是我们可以直接得到答案:

$$\sum_{k\leq n}\sqrt{k}=\frac{2}{3}n^{3/2}+\frac{1}{2}n^{1/2}+\zeta(-1/2)+\frac{1}{24}n^{-1/2}+O(n^{-5/2})$$

这个时候当然就是著名的Faulhaber公式了，因为此时$-r \in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$,求和式子$\sum_{k\leq n}k^{-r}$的求和式子可以直接表达为关于n的多项式:

$$\begin{aligned}\sum_{k\leq n} k^{|r|} &= \frac{1}{|r|+1} \cdot \sum_{j=0}^{|r|}\binom{|r|+1}{j}B_{j} n^{|r|+1-j} \\ &= \frac{1}{1-r}n^{-r+1}+\frac{1}{2}n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12}n^{-r-1}+\cdots+B_{|r|}n\end{aligned}$$

key_techniques_discussed: analytic continuation of the Riemann zeta function
